name: Amazon EC2
tagline: Resizable virtual servers in the cloud
useCase: Host a full-stack project or a game server on a t3.micro instance and learn SSH, security groups and Linux administration along the way.

name: AWS Lambda
useCase: Back a hackathon project's API or a Discord bot with functions that cost nothing when idle and scale automatically when traffic spikes.

name: Amazon S3
tagline: Object storage built to hold anything
useCase: Store datasets for ML coursework, host a static portfolio site, or keep backups of your project assets with versioning turned on.

name: Amazon RDS
useCase: Deploy production-grade PostgreSQL or MySQL databases for your web apps with automated backups, multi-AZ failover, and zero maintenance overhead.

name: Amazon DynamoDB
useCase: Power real-time leaderboards, session tracking, and serverless applications with single-digit millisecond latency at any scale.

name: Amazon Bedrock
tagline: Build Generative AI applications with foundation models
useCase: Integrate cutting-edge AI models (Claude, Llama) with RAG architectures into your student projects without managing GPUs or model hosting infrastructure.
